ForgePact#114 Live 1, 2026-09-30, research build of the #114 branch, character Suh (Samurai, level 100) in Town_02_rm. Blade Barrier (talent 137, abilityCooldown 8 s, level 1) was cast from code (`tgprobe cast 137`) and its cooldown measured as the number of StatSpellHaste reads the ForgePact hook counted while it ran (`statadd list` calls=), one read per step. The hook was installed as a pass-through first, so the bonus-0 runs count too.

source.section: Skill Haste and All Skills in `statadd`

measurements.what: Bonus 0: Blade Barrier's cooldown ran for 392 reads, and 397 in a second run. The character's own Skill Haste was 40 (the first-call line of the next run: `first boosted call 40 -> 140`). Reads came 30 per 0.5 s poll, one per step at 60 steps/s, and none while no cooldown ran.
measurements.model: cooldown_steps(base, 40) with base about 473 steps (8 s at 60 steps/s, less what the cast itself takes): base / 1.2.

source.section: Skill Haste and All Skills in `statadd`

measurements.what: `statadd skillhaste` +100, +120, +160, +200 and +300 over the native 40: the hook returned 140, 160, 200, 240 and 340 (first-call lines 40 -> 140 and 40 -> 340 logged), and the cooldown ran for 280, 265, 238, 238 and 238 reads.
measurements.model: base / (1 + min(total, 200) / 200): totals up to 200 shorten the cooldown as the static reading's 0.005 per point says; 240 and 340 take exactly as long as 200, so the game counts at most 200.
